players.product: dedicated bare-metal AI infrastructure (GPU clusters) designed, deployed, owned and operated for enterprises; Axe Compute Build build-to-order program

quarterly_data.signal: Axe Compute 8-K: on September 11, 2026 Axe sold its wholly owned subsidiary Helomics Corporation - its legacy AI cancer diagnostics lab business and the final operating business from its former identity as Predictive Oncology Inc., renamed in December 2025 - to DataMeds AI, Inc. (NASDAQ: MEDS), closing the same day; the company says this completes its transition to a pure-play neocloud GPU-as-a-Service company.
